snp1.4:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā magadhesu viharati dakkhiṇāgirismiṃ ekanāḷāyaṃ brāhmaṇagāme,
snp1.4:1.3: tena kho pana samayena kasībhāradvājassa brāhmaṇassa pañcamattāni naṅgalasatāni payuttāni honti vappakāle.
snp1.4:1.4: atha kho bhagavā pubbanhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaramādāya yena kasībhāradvājassa brāhmaṇassa kammanto tenupasaṃkami.
snp1.4:1.5: tena kho pana samayena kasībhāradvājassa brāhmaṇassa parivesanāvattati,
snp1.4:1.6: atha kho bhagavā yena parivesanā tenupasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhāsi,
snp1.4:2.1: addasā kho kasībhāradvājo brāhmaṇo bhagavantaṃ piṇḍāya ṭhitaṃ.
snp1.4:2.3: ahaṃ kho samaṇa kasāmi ca vapāmi ca kasitvā ca vapitvā ca bhuñjāmi
snp1.4:2.4: tvampi samaṇa kasassu ca vapassu ca kasitvā ca vapitvā ca bhuñjassūti.
snp1.4:3.1: ahampi kho brāhmaṇa kasāmi ca vapāmi ca kasitvā ca vapitvā ca bhuñjāmīti.
snp1.4:3.2: na kho pana mayaṃ passāma gotamassa yugaṃ vā naṅgalaṃ vā phālaṃ vā pācanaṃ vā balivadde vā,
snp1.4:3.3: atha ca pana bhavaṃ gotamo evamāha:
snp1.4:3.4: ahampi kho brāhmaṇa kasāmi ca vapāmi ca kasitvā ca vapitvā ca bhuñjāmīti,
snp1.4:4.1: atha kho kasībhāradvājo brāhmaṇo bhagavantaṃ gāthāya ajjhabhāsi:
snp1.4:10.1: atha kho kasībhāradvājo brāhmaṇo mahatiyā kaṃsapātiyā pāyāsaṃ vaḍḍhetvā bhagavato upanāmesi,
snp1.4:10.4: yaṃ hi bhavaṃ gotamo amataphalaṃ kasiṃ kasatīti.
snp1.4:13.1: atha kassa cāhaṃ bho gotama imaṃ pāyāsaṃ dammīti,
snp1.4:13.2: na khvāhaṃ taṃ brāhmaṇa passāmi sadevake loke samārake sabrahmake sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiyā pajāya sadevamanussāya yassa so pāyāso bhutto sammā pariṇāmaṃ gaccheyya aññatra tathāgatassa vā tathāgatasāvakassa vā,
snp1.4:13.3: tena hi tvaṃ brāhmamaṇa taṃ pāyāsaṃ appaharite vā chaḍḍehi, appāṇake vā udake opilāpehīti,
snp1.4:14.1: atha kho kasībhāradvājo brāhmaṇo taṃ pāyāsaṃ appāṇake udake opilāpesi.
snp1.4:14.2: atha kho so pāyāso udake pakkhitto cicciṭāyati ciṭiciṭāyati sandhūpāyati sampadhūpāyati,
snp1.4:14.3: seyyathāpi nāma phālo divasasantatto udake pakkhitto cicciṭāyati ciṭiciṭāyati sandhūpāyati sampadhūpāyati,
snp1.4:14.4: evameva so pāyāso udake pakkhitto cicciṭāyati ciṭiciṭāyati sandhūpāyati sampadhūpāyati,
snp1.4:15.1: atha kho kasībhāradvājo brāhmaṇo saṃviggo lomahaṭṭhajāto yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavato pādesu sirasā nipatitvā bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
snp1.4:15.2: abhikkantaṃ bho gotama abhikkantaṃ bho gotama
snp1.4:15.3: seyyathāpi bho gotama nikkujjitaṃ vā ukkujjeyya paṭicchannaṃ vā vivareyya mūḷhassa vā maggaṃ ācikkheyya andhakāre vā telapajjātaṃ dhāreyya cakkhumanto rūpāni dakkhintīti, evamevaṃ bhotā gotamena anekapariyāyena dhammo pakāsito
snp1.4:15.4: esāhaṃ bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ saraṇaṃ gacchāmi dhammañca bhikkhusaṅghañca,
snp1.4:15.5: labheyyāhaṃ bhoto gotamassa santike pabbajjaṃ, labheyyaṃ upasampadanti.
snp1.4:16.1: alattha kho kasībhāradvājo brāhmaṇo bhagavato santike pabbajjaṃ alattha upasampadaṃ,
snp1.4:16.2: acirūpasampanno kho panāyasmā bhāradvājo eko vūpakaṭṭhe appamatto ātāpī pahitatto viharanto na cirasse va yassatthāya kulaputtā sammadeva agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajanti. tadanuttaraṃ brahmacariyapariyosānaṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja vihāsi.
snp1.4:16.3: khīṇā jāti vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ nāparaṃ itthattāyāti abbhaññāsi
snp1.4:16.4: aññataroca kho panāyasmā bhāradvājo arahataṃ ahosīti.
